title: 監視の適用範囲が版ずれ・経路外で欠け、Token/Sub-agent行動の一部が監視Logに載らない
summary: METR reports 16% of ~971B tokens unaccounted for in centralized logging, and outdated Inspect versions skip sub-agent monitoring, so monitoring coverage silently varies by harness version and routing path. Mitigations: central inference routing and version enforcement.

evidence.title: Implementing and Evaluating a Basic Per-Action Monitor for Safer Evals - METR
evidence.summary: 16% of ~971B tokens unaccounted; outdated Inspect skips sub-agent monitoring.

notes: Related to F22, K11, EACDFFF4 (silent blind spots) but specific: version skew disables sub-agent monitoring and unrouted tokens. Low confidence as distinct problem; may merge into EACDFFF4/F22.
